_about: Hand-written rules that turn recognized signs into English. Not AI: each rule is a fixed pattern. {X} stands for any one sign or fingerspelled word. A pattern must match the whole line (unknown '?' segments are ignored). A line can also complete the line just before it, e.g. F-O-R-C-E then MEAN. When no rule matches, the signs are shown as plain words. The raw signs are always shown underneath.

rules.note: In ASL a question is marked on the face (eyebrows), which STAT can't see, so X MEAN is read as a question.
